papers.title_en: Brain Age Gap Progression in Individuals at Risk for Neurodegeneration
papers.evidence: 面向脑影像生物标志物的图信号处理神经网络
papers.tldr: 脑龄差是监测神经退行的重要影像生物标志物，但其在高风险人群中的纵向变化仍不清楚。研究基于协方差神经网络（VNN）从神经影像构建脑龄差，并结合阿尔茨海默病进展评分（APS）进行纵向分析。结果显示，基线疾病进展风险越高，随访中脑龄差增长越快。该发现提示脑龄差可受AD临床/生物学风险调控，并用于高风险人群分层。
papers.abstract_en: Neuroimaging is a widely used modality for characterizing neurodegeneration in various health conditions. Brain age gap has emerged as a promising biomarker for monitoring brain health from neuroimaging data using machine learning algorithms. Recent studies have leveraged coVariance neural networks (VNN)-driven pipelines based on the advancements in graph signal processing for relatively transparent construction of brain age gap from neuroimaging data. In this paper, we focus on a longitudinal study of VNN-based brain age gap in conjunction with Alzheimer's Progression Score (APS) in individuals that are at a higher risk of neurodegeneration due to family history of Alzheimer's disease. APS is a multimodal marker of disease progression. The longitudinal analysis of APS and VNN-derived brain age gap metrics revealed that a higher risk of disease progression at baseline predicted a larger rate of increase in brain age gap in follow-up visits. Thus, our findings revealed potential stratification in the brain age gap modulated by clinical/biological risks of AD in the at-risk population.

papers.title_en: Transferable conditional brain charts link cortico-subcortical structure to Alzheimer's disease progression
papers.authors: Nitin Sharma, Sicheng Dai, Francesco A. Mallus, Atharva Kand, Marc Lemnitzer, Minh-Hieu Nguyen, Mebin Muhammed Hamzakoya Sulaikha, Jijia Xing, Mariam Zabihi, Gülce Lale, Gokul Perumbayil Vijayakrishnan, Elias Schreiner, Madhumitha Sivakumar Punitha, Paul Buttkus, Çağatay Yıldız, Poornima Kumar, Thomas Grote, Esten Leonardsen, Francesco Sammarco, Vinod Kumar Jangir, Sarah Sobotta, Barbora Rehák Bučková, Augustijn A. A. de Boer, Konstantinos Tsilimparis, Christian Gaser, Charlotte Fraza, Saige Rutherford, Seyed Mostafa Kia, Andre F. Marquand, Yanwu Yang, Richard Dinga, Thomas Wolfers
papers.evidence: 面向阿尔茨海默病进展的可迁移脑皮层厚度常模图谱
papers.tldr: 脑图谱常按皮层厚度建立常模，却忽略皮层与皮层下结构的依赖关系，跨站点迁移也需重训练。本文用皮层下体积对皮层厚度寿命常模做条件化，并让模型可迁移。在216个站点、21351名健康人中，条件化改善了样本外预测。仅校准截距即可适配多数新站点，且在ADNI中可预测痴呆转化。
papers.abstract_en: Normative models chart how brain measures vary across the lifespan, expressing each individual as a deviation from a healthy reference. However, most regional models of cortical thickness disregard dependencies between cortical and subcortical anatomy, and transferring them to a new site typically requires retraining or a recalibration of location and scale alone. We condition lifespan norms of cortical thickness on subcortical volume, such that each deviation indicates whether an individual's cortex lies within the healthy range given their subcortical anatomy, and make them transferable. In 21,351 healthy individuals from 216 sites, conditioning on ten subcortical structures improved out-of-sample prediction on average, most for the amygdala and hippocampus. Refitting only the intercepts of all four distributional parameters on about 20 healthy individuals, as implemented in our open-source package NormGAMLSS, calibrated most of six unseen sites without retraining, for base and conditional models. In the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative, global deviation and structural dissociation (the reduction in mean absolute deviation under conditioning) predicted conversion to mild cognitive impairment and dementia beyond the Clinical Dementia Rating and dissociation added beyond global deviation for dementia, even at similar clinically recorded impairment. Conditional norms thus provide relevant, individual-level information.

papers.title_en: AI-Enhanced Hyperspectral Imaging for Intraoperative Detection of Low-Grade Glioma: A Clinical Study
papers.authors: Siri Willems, Ishika Jain, Jens De Winne, Siri Luthman, Hamed Zivari Adab, Roeland Vandebriel, Anna Alperovich, Xiaohan Zhang, Ben Stoffelen, Tom De Schepper, Lien Solie, Steven De Vleeschouwer
papers.evidence: AI增强脑成像用于低级别胶质瘤术中检测
papers.tldr: 低级别胶质瘤在白光显微镜下与正常脑组织高度相似，现有术中影像导航成本高、敏感性有限且操作复杂。本研究在配对组织位置和相同患者级数据划分下，比较高光谱成像与RGB成像分类，并融合光谱与空间特征构建3D CNN。结果显示肿瘤区反射率持续偏低，3D CNN中位ROC-AUC达74.5%，优于纯光谱XGBoost的67.9%和RGB模型的64.0%。该工作为低级别胶质瘤术中检测提供了临床证据，并量化了HSI相对常规RGB成像的增益。
papers.abstract_en: Current image-guided neuronavigation techniques, such as intraoperative MRI and ultrasound, are limited by high costs, limited sensitivity and operational complexity. There is a clear need for more efficient systems to enhance intra-operative tumor detection and improve patient outcomes for intrinsic brain tumor resection. Whereas previous intraoperative brain HSI studies have predominantly investigated high-grade gliomas, glioblastomas, or mixed-grade cohorts, this clinical study focuses specifically on low-grade gliomas (LGGs). LGGs strongly resemble normal brain under white light conditions on the operative microscope. This study characterizes spectral differences between healthy and tumor tissue and provides a paired comparison of HSI- and RGB-based classification at matched tissue locations and under identical patient-level data splits. Tumor regions showed consistently lower reflectance, which may be associated with differences in hemoglobin concentration and oxygenation. A range of classification models was evaluated. The 3D CNN, which integrates spectral and spatial features, achieved the highest median ROC-AUC of 74.5%, compared with 67.9% for the spectral-only XGBoost model and 64.0% for the RGB-based model. These results support further investigation of HSI for low-grade glioma classification and quantify its performance relative to conventional RGB imaging in this cohort.
